propositions: When re-reviewing a ticket with an outstanding BLOCK verdict, extract and compare cited evidence anchors from blocking findings against the current plan material to detect unchanged plan text.

If all matchable anchors remain verbatim present and the description component fingerprint is unchanged, emit a warn-only message naming the persisting blocking criteria before running the review (never hard-block).

Anchors that cannot be matched verbatim (paraphrased or structural findings with no quote) do not trigger the warning independently; warning fires only when at least one anchor matches and all matched anchors are untouched.
Record precheck.cited_anchor_warning (true/false) in the review sidecar metrics to measure warning hit rate and predictive value for offline analysis.
